text: The homotopy groups of a Kan complex K at vertex v are defined as:
choices: the groups [Δ[n]/∂Δ[n], K]_v of based maps
explanation: πₙ(K, v) can be defined entirely simplicially: homotopy classes of maps (Δ[n], ∂Δ[n]) → (K, v). This agrees with the topological πₙ of |K| via the Kan-Quillen equivalence.
